facts.text: The Jim and Linda Lee Planetarium is the only Arizona planetarium north of Phoenix.

sources.title: Creating Local Connections - Lift Magazine
sources.quote: The center's planetarium was recently named the Jim and Linda Lee Planetarium in the couple's honor. The only Arizona planetarium north of Phoenix, it can seat 125 people for presentations in full 360-degree high definition.
